about.intro: I'm a *Software Engineering Student* & *Web Developer* based at **Amity University, Gwalior**.
about.description: Pursuing a Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) with a strong interest in software development and technology research. Driven to build **efficient, scalable, and user-friendly** applications.
about.full:
Hi, I'm **Rza Mohammed**. I am currently pursuing a Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) at Amity University, Gwalior, with a strong interest in software development and technology research. My goal is to become a skilled Software Engineer capable of building efficient, scalable, and user-friendly applications.

I actively participate in hackathons, business competitions, and technical events to challenge myself beyond academics and enhance my real-world problem-solving approach. During my journey, I have secured 1st position in the SISTec competition and achieved the 2nd Runner-Up position at IIITM, where I collaborated with a team to develop and pitch innovative solutions. These experiences improved my coding skills, teamwork, leadership, and presentation abilities.

I am continuously learning new technologies, building projects, and exploring software development as a career path. I aim to join a growth-oriented environment where I can contribute meaningfully and evolve as a technology professional.

projects.title: Brand Combat Solution
projects.description: Secured 1st Position with team in the Brand Combat competition at SISTec Business School – Sagar Exuberance 4.0, Bhopal. Developed and presented an innovative business technology solution demonstrating market strategy, software implementation, and pitch presentation.

projects.title: IIITM Hackathon & Innovation Pitch
projects.description: Achieved 2nd Runner-Up position at IIITM Gwalior. Collaborated in a high-intensity hackathon environment to engineer, build, and pitch an innovative technology product addressing complex user problems.

projects.title: Arjuna 2.0 – Tech Summit Platform
projects.description: Completed Arjuna 2.0 – Northeast Tech Summit 2025 certification from the National Institute of Technology (NIT), Agartala. Showcased event coordination and tech project management skills for large-scale tech initiatives.

projects.title: Amity Coding Club Initiatives
projects.description: Technical Team Member at Amity Coding Club. Contributed to coding activities, workshops, collaborative session challenges, and campus project developments.
